q0.question: What is Edu Assist and how does it help?
q0.answer: Edu Assist analyzes and organizes your academic emails, labels messages by course, and drafts replies, saving you time.

q1.question: Do I need to give full inbox access?
q1.answer: You connect via secure OAuth. We request the minimum scopes to read and organize messages; you can revoke access anytime.

q2.question: Which email providers are supported?
q2.answer: Gmail and Outlook is supported today.

q3.question: Can it reply to students automatically?
q3.answer: Yes—on Pro plans you can enable auto‑replies for routine questions (syllabus, deadlines, links) with your tone.

q4.question: Is my data private and secure?
q4.answer: Yes. We store only what is needed, encrypt data in transit and at rest, and you can delete your data at any time.

q5.question: How do billing and trials work?
q5.answer: Start with a free trial. Upgrade anytime from the Pricing page; cancel anytime from Settings > Billing.
